NY Governor and Challenger Clash in Debate

New York Governor Kathy Hochul and her challenger, Lee Zeldin, engaged in a heated debate covering topics including former President Trump, political figure Mohsin Mamdani, and the cost of living. During the exchange, Hochul deflected questions about her ties to Mamdani, who was described in one report as 'anti-Christian', by accusing Zeldin of shame.
